description: Per-bar structure cases with harmony and timbre (SM3-D17), shared by test_smart_mix_structure.py and tools/crate-cli/tests/smart_mix_structure.rs. Inputs per bar: bars ([startBeat, startMs, endMs]), levels (dB), shapes (band balance, dB), music, chroma (12 pitch classes) and mfcc (13 coefficients), as the analyzers compute them from frames. Expected values come from app/crate/smart_mix/structure.py. mfccReference holds a fixed 128-band mel-dB frame and its first 13 coefficients of the orthonormal DCT-II (scipy.fft.dct(x, type=2, norm="ortho")[:13]), the MFCC both analyzers compute.
